Package edu.bu.pas.hex

Class Game

java.lang.Object
edu.bu.pas.hex.GameView
edu.bu.pas.hex.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
GenericGame, Serializable
public class Game extends GameView
The mutable game state for a game of Hex.

Extends GameView with methods that modify the board and manage turns. You can get a mutable Game object from an immutable GameView object using: 


      Game game = new Game(gameView);
      GameView gameView = new GameView(game);

This class is the authoritative game state. Agents never receive a direct reference to this instance; instead, they receive an immutable snapshot.
